```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(yaml)

# publications.yml is the single source of truth — see the comments at its top.
pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")

# Escape HTML, then honour the **bold** / *italic* markers used in the YAML.
md_inline <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("")
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;",  x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*", "<b>\\1</b>", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\*(.+?)\\*",       "<i>\\1</i>", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

field <- function(p, name) if (is.null(p[[name]])) NULL else p[[name]]

# One entry: year (or blank) in the left column, citation in the right.
render_entry <- function(p) {
  doi   <- field(p, "doi")
  title <- md_inline(p$title)

  title_html <- if (is.null(doi)) {
    sprintf('<span class="pub-title">%s</span>', title)
  } else {
    sprintf('<a class="pub-title" href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
            doi, title)
  }

  venue <- md_inline(field(p, "venue"))
  bits  <- character(0)
  if (nzchar(venue)) bits <- c(bits, venue)
  if (!is.null(field(p, "status"))) {
    bits <- c(bits, sprintf('<span class="pub-status">%s</span>', p$status))
  }
  if (!is.null(field(p, "preprint"))) {
    bits <- c(bits, sprintf(
      '<a class="pub-status pub-status--link" href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">preprint</a>',
      p$preprint))
  }

  sprintf(paste0('<div class="pub-item">\n',
                 '<div class="pub-when">%s</div>\n',
                 '<div class="pub-body">\n%s\n',
                 '<div class="pub-authors">%s</div>\n',
                 '<div class="pub-venue">%s</div>\n',
                 '</div>\n</div>\n'),
          if (is.null(field(p, "year"))) "" else p$year,
          title_html,
          md_inline(field(p, "authors")),
          paste(bits, collapse = " · "))
}

render_list <- function(items) {
  if (length(items) == 0) {
    cat('<p class="pub-empty">Nothing here at the moment.</p>\n')
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  cat('<div class="pub-list">\n')
  for (p in items) cat(render_entry(p))
  cat('</div>\n')
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r intro, results='asis'}
n_pub  <- length(pubs$published)
yrs    <- unlist(lapply(pubs$published, function(p) p$year))
cat(sprintf(
  paste0("A complete list of my publications. Titles link to the published version ",
         "wherever one exists.\n\n",
         "::: {.pub-count}\n**%d** published works · **%d** in review · ",
         "**%d** in preparation · spanning **%d–%d**\n:::\n"),
  n_pub, length(pubs$in_review), length(pubs$in_progress),
  min(yrs), max(yrs)))
```

## Review services

I have reviewed for the following journals:

-   Frontiers in Veterinary Science
-   Herpetologica
-   Conservation Genetics
-   PLoS ONE
-   Biological Invasion
-   Journal for Nature Conservation
-   Integrative Zoology
-   Oecologia

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  const box = document.getElementById('pub-filter');
  const list = document.getElementById('published-list');
  if (!box || !list) return;
  const status = document.getElementById('pub-filter-status');

  // Strip diacritics so typing "galapagos" still finds "Galápagos".
  const norm = s => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();

  const items = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll('.pub-item'))
    .map(el => ({ el: el, text: norm(el.textContent) }));

  box.addEventListener('input', function () {
    const q = norm(box.value.trim());
    let shown = 0;
    items.forEach(function (item) {
      const hit = q === '' || item.text.includes(q);
      item.el.hidden = !hit;
      if (hit) shown++;
    });
    status.textContent = q === ''
      ? ''
      : shown + ' of ' + items.length + ' published works match “' + box.value.trim() + '”';
  });
})();
</script>
```
